description: This file defines a function `parseCookieHeader` that parses an HTTP cookie header string according to RFC 6265, extracting cookie name-value pairs possibly encoded with URL encoding. The function uses regular expressions to identify cookie parts and returns an associative array of cookie names and decoded values.

methods.name: parseCookieHeader
methods.description: Parses a cookie header string and returns an associative array of cookie names and their URL-decoded values.
